name: DDC .NET Developer Conference 2026
description: German .NET and C# conference with workshop and DevSession days
note: on-site, mostly German (not stated); workshops 23 Nov, sessions 24-25 Nov, DevSessions 26 Nov; aggregator lists 515-2,190 EUR
details:
DDC is a German conference for .NET developers run by developer-world (Ebner Media): full-day workshops on Monday 23 November, two session days on 24-25 November and half-day DevSessions on Thursday 26 November. Topics: .NET, C#, Blazor, MAUI, cloud, AI, software architecture and testing; 50+ sessions, 14 workshops and DevSessions, about 50 speakers and about 480 attendees.

Tickets: combo (workshop + conference + DevSession), 1- or 2-day conference, or workshop only; prices are only in the ticket shop (an aggregator lists 515-2,190 EUR). Group, student and apprentice discounts on request. Talk language is not stated; the site is German.
